observations.trace: The current general marching_tetrahedra call search finds erosional_terrain::patch and the comparison fixture. The separate fault extractor calls marching_height_surface with a closure whose X/Z depend on x/z and whose Y depends only on y. It checks recipe and side/vertical upper limits before marching; the height helper checks each shared elevation finite and strictly increasing, finite column endpoints and endpoint differences, and dimensions at least2.
observations.remaining: The finite recipe dimensions do not by themselves prove every intermediate support/field scalar or all native geometry; earlier late-bound preprocessing findings remain distinct. Tests are source only.

observations.trace: Generated triangles use f64 for winding, f32 cross products for normals, discard exactly-zero normal triangles, normalize_or_zero accumulated vertex normals, then call the checked immutable patch constructor. The constructor checks finite arrays, shape and index bounds; collider concatenation checks total u32 vertex capacity, and client consumes admitted buffers for mesh attributes.
observations.remaining: The selected native source and explicit public-constructor counterexample do not establish runtime validity, renderer results, native flags in every build or a production malformed input.

observations.trace: TacticalSceneInput validates grid dimensions and spacing and limits authored height samples to finite ±12,000m. The independent public SceneTerrain::from_heightmap validates grid cardinality, finite positive scale and finite samples but has no same height bound.
observations.remaining: Other generation/refinement and landform field arithmetic must be traced before extending either numerical bound to every caller.

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; retained historical leaf issue with current actual-producer reachability open
conditional_findings.first_contract: A finite sign-changing field edge must place its crossing correctly or reject the arithmetic before producing a mesh.
conditional_findings.classification: Original059 Adler finding independently reassessed on the identical95e helper body; no new historical finding.
conditional_findings.trace: sample_field accepts finite field values and positions after near-zero snap. Every emitted edge is requested from an inside sample to an outside sample. For hypothetical start=-f32::MAX and end=+f32::MAX, their f32 subtraction becomes negative infinity and the fraction becomes positive zero rather than one half. Pinned glam Vec3::lerp at zero returns the finite start point. Symbolically, on a 2×2×2 unit lattice with the origin inside at -MAX and all other vertices outside at +MAX, all six tetrahedra touch the origin; their interpolated edge positions collapse there, their zero normals are discarded and build_surface returns EmptySurface. No closure, lattice, scalar operation, mesh or product ran.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The only non-test current general caller is erosional_terrain::patch, with bounded recipe dimensions, fixed spacing, required finite support queries and per-sample field checks; no supported erosion field producing these extremes is established. The fault path uses the trimmed height specialization, which checks finite endpoint subtractions and monotone shared Y before extraction. TacticalSceneInput separately limits authored height samples to ±12,000m; public SceneTerrain accepts a broader finite range. The finite-buffer patch constructor rejects nonfinite output, so do not claim a nonfinite patch was published.
connected_repair_dependencies: Trace the full supported erosional-field and SceneTerrain producer ranges and exact aliases; distinguish generic-helper admission from reachable production.
If the complete edge operation must support the larger finite domain, compute or reject the full ratio safely while preserving near-zero snap, stable edge keys, winding and ordinary mesh ordering.
Later authorized verification should cover sign-changing extremes, ordinary endpoints, snapped zeros, empty surfaces and the actual accepted producer; no product validation ran.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; same current operation and symbolic leaf consequence established, actual supported field extremes and all aliases remain open

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional public patch geometry and native boundary policy
conditional_findings.first_contract: The admitted terrain-patch boundary and its native consumers need an explicit shared policy for degenerate triangles and zero or nonunit normals.
conditional_findings.trace: SceneTerrainPatch::from_mesh_buffers rejects empty buffers, unequal normal and vertex counts, too many vertices, non-triangle index counts, out-of-range indices and nonfinite components; its comment says producers supply unit normals. For a valid collar, three identical finite positions, three zero normals and indices [0,1,2] satisfy the shown checks, as does a nonzero finite but nonunit normal. PatchWire deserialization calls the same constructor. The public collider path forwards positions and index triples to Avian Collider::trimesh; the inspected Avian adapter delegates to Parry SharedShape::trimesh, whose TriMesh::new selects empty preprocessing flags. This establishes a source-level admission and handoff question, not an executed collider or a claimed panic.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The generated marching path filters zero-area triangles before final admission and normalizes with normalize_or_zero; zero accumulated normals can be a deliberate representation for unused or canceling vertices. Normal scene production creates a checked patch internally and does not replicate SceneTerrainPatch in the selected registry. No real serialized malformed patch, native renderer/collider result, ordinary generated degenerate output or violated promised consumer requirement has been demonstrated. Parry source with empty flags does not justify inferring duplicate-vertex rejection merely from Avian documentation.
connected_repair_dependencies: Determine supported public/wire patch ingress and the actual Bevy/Avian contracts for geometry, normals, duplicate positions and triangle winding; trace every normal producer and consumer before changing admission.
If a stricter invariant is required, enforce it at the patch owner or propagate a typed native rejection while preserving intentional zero-normal/unused-vertex and tiny valid triangle behavior.
Later authorized verification should distinguish zero-area, duplicate-position, valid small triangles, nonunit normals and ordinary generated patches; no physics or renderer ran.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; exact constructor gap and selected native handoff shown, supported ingress, native requirements, consumer impact and aliases remain open
